verdict.rationale: Windows publishes official SDKs (Windows App SDK, WinUI 3) and even a dedicated 'Windows AI Foundoundry toolkit' for AI-native development, per first-party docs. However, the AI SDK is only mentioned in a single line with no depth, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of building against it. Missing for 10: detailed AI Foundry SDK documentation/API reference, developer testimonials or hands-on validation of the AI SDK, and clarity on scope/maturity of the AI-specific tooling.
